  ) DESC
LIMIT 100

query: sub sentential alignment using substring co occurrence counts
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'sub-sentential | subsentential')
    OR to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'sub-sentential | subsentential')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%sub-sentential%' OR p.title ILIKE '%subsentential%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%alignment%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%alignment%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%substring%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%substring%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%co-occurrence%' OR p.title ILIKE '%cooccurrence%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%co-occurrence%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%cooccurrence%')
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'sub-sentential | subsentential alignment substring co-occurrence cooccurrence')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count

LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id

WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%the good the bad and the unknown morphosyllabic sentiment tagging of unseen words%'

   OR p.title ILIKE '%morphosyllabic sentiment tagging%'

  AND (
    a.name ILIKE '%karo moilanen%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%karo moilanen%'

ORDER BY

     WHEN p.title ILIKE 'the good the bad and the unknown morphosyllabic sentiment tagging of unseen words' THEN 3
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%the good the bad and the unknown morphosyllabic sentiment tagging of unseen words%' THEN 2
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%morphosyllabic sentiment tagging%' THEN 1
     ELSE 0
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: mt quality estimation for computer assisted translation does it really help, university of bristol
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON pa.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (
    (p.title ILIKE '%mt quality estimation%' OR
     p.title ILIKE '%machine translation quality estimation%' OR
     p.title ILIKE '%quality estimation%' OR
     p.abstract ILIKE '%mt quality estimation%' OR
     p.abstract ILIKE '%machine translation quality estimation%' OR
     p.abstract ILIKE '%quality estimation%' OR
     p.title ILIKE '%computer assisted translation%' OR
     p.abstract ILIKE '%computer assisted translation%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%does it really help%' OR
         p.abstract ILIKE '%does it really help%')
)
AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%university of bristol%' OR
    i.display_name ILIKE '%bristol%'
)
ORDER BY
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%mt quality estimation%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%mt quality estimation%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%computer assisted translation%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%computer assisted translation%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%university of bristol%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%bristol%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     LEAST(p.citation_count, 100) / 100.0) DESC
LIMIT 100

query: translating named entities using monolingual and bilingual resources
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%named entit%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%named entit%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%translat%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%entity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%translat%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%')
  )
  OR (
    p.title ILIKE '%monolingual%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%monolingual%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%bilingual%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%bilingual%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%named entit% translat%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%named entit% translat%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%named entit%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%named entit%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%translat%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%monolingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%monolingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%bilingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%bilingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,

    OR p.title ILIKE '%translation domain adaptation%'

query: finding word substitutions using a distributional similarity baseline and immediate context overlap
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    p.title ILIKE '%word substitution%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%substitute word%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%substitution task%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lexical choice%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%paraphrase generation%'
  )
  OR (
    p.abstract ILIKE '%word substitution%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%substitute word%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%substitution task%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical choice%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%paraphrase generation%'
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%distributional similarity%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%context%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%context%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%context overlap%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%context overlap%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%substitution%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%substitution%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%word substitution%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%context overlap%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%word substitution%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical substitution%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%distributional similarity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%context overlap%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count

     OR (p.title ILIKE '%lexical meaning%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%lexical meaning%')

  AND (
        i.display_name ILIKE '%university of cambridge%'
     OR i.display_name ILIKE '%cambridge university%'
  )

   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%concreteness%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%subjectivity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%subjectivity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%lexical meaning%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.citation_count

JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2018
  AND a.name ILIKE '%taeuk kim%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%dynamic compositionality%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%recursive neural network%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%structure aware tag%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%dynamic compositionality%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%recursive neural network%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%structure aware tag%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dynamic compositionality in recursive neural networks with structure aware tag representations%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dynamic compositionality%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%recursive neural network%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%structure aware tag%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%taeuk kim%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  p.abstract,

    plainto_tsquery('english', 'hierarchical model reviews aspect based sentiment analysis')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
